title: Identification of an explicit external section component on an open subscheme
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(k)$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}(k)$ be scheme morphisms [def-pc-scheme], $F,G$ module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and $V\subseteq Y$ any open, including the empty open. For the explicitly constructed $c_V$ of [lem-sc-external-sections-components], there are $k$-linear source and target section isomorphisms $e_S,e_T$ identifying its source with $\Gamma(X,F)\otimes_k\Gamma(V,G|_V)$ and its target with the external-coefficient global sections on $X\times_k V$. Under these isomorphisms $c_V$ equals the canonical external tensor map of [def-sc-scalar-global-sections-comparison] for $f,V\to Y\to\operatorname{Spec}(k),F,G|_V$. This assertion concerns a single explicit component and imposes no cover, affineness, quasi-coherence or finiteness assumptions.

proof.text: Use the canonical pullback.map of identity on X, V.ι and identity on Spec(k). Its projection equations follow from pullback.map_fst and map_snd; Scheme.Pullback.range_map identifies its image with pr_2 inverse-image V, including V empty. Apply the normalized coefficient isomorphism and its section equation.

Construct the source section isomorphism by scalar restriction along V.ι. Prove its k-linearity from scalarMap_pullback, the open-immersion appIso and smul_restrictAppIso_inv, then tensor on the left with Gamma(X,F). Apply the same scalar restriction construction along the base-change immersion to the original coefficient, and compose with the coefficient isomorphism evaluated at the top open and restricted to scalars k, obtaining eT. The structure-map equality follows from the first projection equation.

Apply ModuleCat.hom_ext and TensorProduct.ext'. On a pure tensor, the source tensor isomorphism sends t to its restriction section and the target isomorphism is restriction followed by the coefficient isomorphism. The normalized coefficient section equation is exactly the required equality. Tensor extensionality closes the comparison for all tensors.

lean.statement:
theorem externalSectionsComponent_openComparison
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) (V : Y.Opens) :
    ∃ eS : ModuleCat.of k (scalarObj f F (op ⊤) ⊗[k] scalarObj g G (op V)) ≅
        ModuleCat.of k (scalarObj f F (op ⊤) ⊗[k]
          scalarObj (V.ι ≫ g) (G.restrict V.ι) (op ⊤)),
    ∃ eT : scalarObj (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)
        (op (pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V)) ≅
        scalarObj (pullback.fst f (V.ι ≫ g) ≫ f)
          (externalCupCoefficients f (V.ι ≫ g) F (G.restrict V.ι)) (op ⊤),
      externalSectionsComponent f g F G V ≫ eT.hom = eS.hom ≫
        ModuleCat.ofHom
          (externalGlobalSectionsTensor f (V.ι ≫ g) F (G.restrict V.ι))
